parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no facility or border rule turning on gender, and foreign passports are checked ordinarily — so there is no universal-exposure or state-targeting tier-1/tier-2 feature. But the outed visitor faces a hostile climate: the 2024 education 'propaganda' law condemns non-biological gender identity, the dominant church and far-right frame gender diversity as a threat, documented anti-LGBT violence (2008 park killing, 2020 assault, petrol-bomb attack on Pride) sits with a documented 2015 failure to identify bias motivation, and Pride itself needs heavy police guard. The 2024 LGBTIQ survey shows pervasive self-restriction, though it is LGBT-wide rather than trans-specific. Legal gender recognition is closed (resident-facing), and service/discrimination enforcement is incomplete. No documented trans-specific violence against visitors, no organized targeting, no birth-sex custody or ward rule — so this sits below the acceptance-with-working-remedies tier but above jurisdictions with unremedied institutional exclusion.
